integrity: The result is an exact consequence of the full-text spectral conjugacy and cone-bijection statements. Every compatible state is realizable after one admissible warm-up step. A finite numerical replay checks representative instances but is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional strictly convex quadratics with a fixed positive spectral weight commuting with the Hessian. The equality is for the weight-matched product norm; it does not assert equality of Euclidean transient gains, and it does not cover iteration-dependent weights or nonlinear objectives.
title: Exact finite-horizon universality of fixed spectral-weight BB dynamics in matched norms
